The viewing stands for the Libraland nobles and the Fort of Justice Inquisitor were also targeted, with the number of casualties still unknown.

Large-scale assault on civilians is never acceptable, and those responsible must face justice. #rLibraland and Fort of Justice already have too many enemies. Right now, we need every bit of strength we can find. [player], in the name of House Hellason and Fort of Justice, I invite you to troubled Peakmount City.
